styleDescriptions.photo: A true-to-life photograph in soft studio light
styleDescriptions.film: A cinematic 35 mm photograph with natural light and grain
styleDescriptions.render: A polished 3D render with studio light and real materials
styleDescriptions.isometric: A tidy 3D model at the isometric angle
styleDescriptions.miniature: A real scene photographed like a tiny scale model
styleDescriptions.clay: Soft handmade modelling clay in warm light
styleDescriptions.glass: Sculpted translucent glass with refraction and caustics
styleDescriptions.neon: Glowing neon tubes against deep darkness
styleDescriptions.enamel: Glossy cloisonné enamel with raised gold outlines
styleDescriptions.embroidery: Dense satin-stitch embroidery in raised glossy thread
styleDescriptions.papercut: Layered cut paper with real shadows between the layers
styleDescriptions.stained-glass: Jewel-toned leaded glass lit from behind
styleDescriptions.oil: Rich classical oil paint with dramatic light
styleDescriptions.gouache: Opaque matte paint in flat, harmonious shapes
styleDescriptions.pencil: A detailed graphite drawing with a full tonal range
styleDescriptions.airbrush: Silky gradients, glossy chrome and star glints
styleDescriptions.woodblock: Carved keylines, flat colour and wood grain
styleDescriptions.linocut: Bold carved relief in black and one ink
styleDescriptions.risograph: Grainy spot colour with slight misregistration
styleDescriptions.screenprint: Mid-century flat colour with bold light
styleDescriptions.pop-art: Black outlines, primaries and halftone dots
styleDescriptions.collage: Surreal cut paper and photographic fragments
styleDescriptions.pixel: Crisp 16-bit pixels and a limited palette
styleDescriptions.blueprint: White technical linework on deep blue
styleDescriptions.art-nouveau: Whiplash lines, gold outlines and jewel tones
styleDescriptions.art-deco: Bold symmetrical geometry in gold and black
